author: ojiudezue
title: Dead-channel alert approved: all healthy channels, non-critical, failing-since must survive restarts
summary: Oji approved the dead-channel alert and asked whether it would arrive by WhatsApp. Default given: every still-healthy channel through NM's normal routing with the dead one excluded, at non-critical severity so quiet hours hold; one alert per outage, re-armed on the channel's next success; an HA persistent notification if all channels are dead.
why: One fixed channel (WhatsApp) could itself be the dead one. Critical severity would wake the house over a non-urgent fault. NM channel health is in memory only (notification_manager.py:513/:7163) and resets on every restart; at about one restart a day a naive N-hour counter would rarely fire, which repeats the crossing-ledger lesson (338). Plan dispatched to ura-planner.
alternatives_considered: WhatsApp only (rejected: single point of failure)
Critical severity (rejected: a dead channel isn't worth waking anyone)
